notes.title: Game update v1.0.2
notes.content:
Hi guys! We just posted a new patch to address a number of issues users have been experiencing. We're still working on additional issues, but wanted to get this out as fast as possible.

This patch contains:
* A fix for some audio crashes
* A fix for some stuck in the walls
* A fix for some visual issues
* A fix for rare broken checkpoint issue
* A fix for disable jump

We're reading the reviews and trying to tune the game for the better experience. Thanks so much for playing and to all the folks who've shared info to help us run down some of these issues.
